title: Ucc Financing Statement Source
description: Ucc Financing Statement contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-ucc-financing-statement-source
  title: Ucc Financing Statement Source
  description: Ucc Financing Statement contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_ucc_financing_statement_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/ucc_financing_statement
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/ucc_financing_statement
    sourceVersion: fs_ucc_financing_statement_v1
    sourceDigest: 8ff8955790aea30fd1d81c6d5cba4ad27fdfdc7ea1d983a44c9d1cbba45dde43
    derivedFrom: docubricks-fs-ucc-financing-statement
spec:
  documentType: ucc_financing_statement
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - filing-date
        - lapse-date
        - termination-indicator
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - continuation-indicator
        - filing-jurisdiction
        - filing-number
        - filing-office
        - filing-type
        - fixture-filing-indicator
        - manufactured-home-indicator
        - public-finance-indicator
        - related-filing-number
        - transmitting-utility-indicator
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - assignee-name
        - debtor-names
        - secured-party-addresses
        - secured-party-names
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - collateral-description
        - debtor-addresses
  fields:
    - id: filing-type
      name: filing_type
      label: Filing Type
      description: Initial financing statement, amendment, continuation, assignment, termination, fixture filing, or
        other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/filing_type
    - id: filing-number
      name: filing_number
      label: Filing Number
      description: State filing or document number.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/filing_number
    - id: filing-date
      name: filing_date
      label: Filing Date
      description: Filing date.
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/filing_date
    - id: lapse-date
      name: lapse_date
      label: Lapse Date
      description: Lapse or continuation deadline if present.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/lapse_date
    - id: filing-office
      name: filing_office
      label: Filing Office
      description: Secretary of State, county, or filing office.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/filing_office
    - id: filing-jurisdiction
      name: filing_jurisdiction
      label: Filing Jurisdiction
      description: State or jurisdiction.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/filing_jurisdiction
    - id: debtor-names
      name: debtor_names
      label: Debtor Names
      description: Debtor legal names.
      dataType: array
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/debtor_names
    - id: debtor-addresses
      name: debtor_addresses
      label: Debtor Addresses
      description: Debtor addresses.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/debtor_addresses
    - id: secured-party-names
      name: secured_party_names
      label: Secured Party Names
      description: Secured party names.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/secured_party_names
    - id: secured-party-addresses
      name: secured_party_addresses
      label: Secured Party Addresses
      description: Secured party addresses.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/secured_party_addresses
    - id: collateral-description
      name: collateral_description
      label: Collateral Description
      description: UCC collateral text.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/collateral_description
    - id: fixture-filing-indicator
      name: fixture_filing_indicator
      label: Fixture Filing Indicator
      description: Whether fixture filing is indicated.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/fixture_filing_indicator
    - id: transmitting-utility-indicator
      name: transmitting_utility_indicator
      label: Transmitting Utility Indicator
      description: Whether debtor is transmitting utility.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/transmitting_utility_indicator
    - id: public-finance-indicator
      name: public_finance_indicator
      label: Public Finance Indicator
      description: Public finance transaction indicator.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/public_finance_indicator
    - id: manufactured-home-indicator
      name: manufactured_home_indicator
      label: Manufactured Home Indicator
      description: Manufactured home transaction indicator.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/manufactured_home_indicator
    - id: related-filing-number
      name: related_filing_number
      label: Related Filing Number
      description: Original filing number for amendment, continuation, termination, or assignment.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/related_filing_number
    - id: assignee-name
      name: assignee_name
      label: Assignee Name
      description: Assignee if assignment is present.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/assignee_name
    - id: termination-indicator
      name: termination_indicator
      label: Termination Indicator
      description: Whether filing terminates a record.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/termination_indicator
    - id: continuation-indicator
      name: continuation_indicator
      label: Continuation Indicator
      description: Whether filing continues a record.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/continuation_indicator
  validationRules:
    - id: filing-number-present
      severity: error
      description: UCC filings require a filing number for public-record matching.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: filing_number
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: filing_number
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: filing_number IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(filing_number)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: filing-date-present
      severity: warning
      description: Filing date is required for perfection and lapse monitoring.
      rule:
        op: present
        field: filing_date
      sourceExpression: filing_date IS NOT NULL
      supported: true
    - id: debtor-names-present
      severity: error
      description: At least one debtor name is required.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: debtor_names
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: debtor_names
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: debtor_names IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(debtor_names) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: secured-party-names-present
      severity: warning
      description: Secured party should be present for lien management.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: secured_party_names
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: secured_party_names
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: secured_party_names IS NOT NULL AND JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(secured_party_names) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: lapse-after-filing-date
      severity: warning
      description: Lapse date should be after filing date.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: lapse_date
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: filing_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: lapse_date
            right:
              field: filing_date
      sourceExpression: lapse_date IS NULL OR filing_date IS NULL OR lapse_date > filing_date
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      filing_number:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Filing number is the primary public-record key.
      filing_date:
        minConfidence: 0.93
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Filing date drives perfection and lapse calculations.
      debtor_names:
        minConfidence: 0.94
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Debtor legal names are critical for lien search and perfection.
      secured_party_names:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Secured party names identify lender or agent interest.
      collateral_description:
        minConfidence: 0.85
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Collateral text determines scope of perfection.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-claude-sonnet
    maxTokens: 3072
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: UCC financing statements are structured filing forms. Llama is suitable for high-volume form
      extraction, with Claude retained for messy scanned filings and long collateral text.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      filing_type:
        type: string
        description: Initial financing statement, amendment, continuation, assignment, termination, fixture filing, or
          other.
      filing_number:
        type: string
        description: State filing or document number.
      filing_date:
        type: date
        description: Filing date.
        format: date
      lapse_date:
        type: date
        description: Lapse or continuation deadline if present.
        format: date
      filing_office:
        type: string
        description: Secretary of State, county, or filing office.
      filing_jurisdiction:
        type: string
        description: State or jurisdiction.
      debtor_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Debtor legal names.
      debtor_addresses:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Debtor addresses.
      secured_party_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Secured party names.
      secured_party_addresses:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Secured party addresses.
      collateral_description:
        type: string
        description: UCC collateral text.
      fixture_filing_indicator:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether fixture filing is indicated.
      transmitting_utility_indicator:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether debtor is transmitting utility.
      public_finance_indicator:
        type: boolean
        description: Public finance transaction indicator.
      manufactured_home_indicator:
        type: boolean
        description: Manufactured home transaction indicator.
      related_filing_number:
        type: string
        description: Original filing number for amendment, continuation, termination, or assignment.
      assignee_name:
        type: string
        description: Assignee if assignment is present.
      termination_indicator:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether filing terminates a record.
      continuation_indicator:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether filing continues a record.
    required:
      - filing_number
      - filing_date
      - debtor_names
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: commercial_lending
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - filing_number
          - filing_date
          - debtor_names
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
